notes.title: Sakura And The Airyvixen - Demo is open for a limited time!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/4a657acd11b372180e3ee7c7fb85a967ae5912ee.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710380/_/
《Sakura And The Airyvixen》A Turn-based Rouglite filled with bishoujo. Demo is open for a limited time, navigate through challenges with strategies and the power of dice! Demo is released for a limited time of [b]2 weeks[/b].
The demo includes 3 stages with 7 playable characters.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/b1beedf58d546f9f5a698bf88f5cc252b85b6009.png[/img]
[h1]Strategic Dice Battles[/h1]
The game's combat revolves around dice rolling. Each turn your gain action points by rolling your dice, and you're able to attack until you use up your action points. There are also abilities that do bonus damage or rain debuffs on your enemies if you roll the right number. It's essential for you to form a game plan on top of relying on sheer luck.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/93005ea109c183705b220b97fe0db293b42351dd.png[/img]
[h1]Rougelite Design:[/h1]
You will get to pick a companion to join your team everytime you clear a stage, which will affect your playstyle. Every failed challenge on the other hand turns your temporary abilities into permanent ones to give you an edge for your next adventure!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/b3d1ec11616c93deee2fadd6e35f35d4b86102e4.png[/img]

This is the first time we developed a game of this genre, it's been a real challenge to us and we have spent a lot of time on adjusting the game due to design issue. We may not provide a comparable experience to those renowned titles but we hope to deliver a different kind of fun to you. :)

If you have any advice feel free to leave comments in the forum, not that we promise to address every issue(you know, for adult reasons), but we will make sure to read through all of your comments!

Lastly, don't forget to wishlist the game and follow our news!
[h2]WISHLIST OUR NEW GAME![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710380/
Serials
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/6a7c2cec6ce776a371f525c2fa2a5c6a768e2889.jpg[/img]
[h2]【Story】[/h2]
After studying away from your hometown, you return back home.
Hoping to be able to rest, but instead brought to the endless farmland. With the "NO WORK, NO EAT" tradition, The daily life of rookie farmer and rice-hime begins.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/617660/DongJin_Ricehime

notes.title: Sakura And The Airyvixen - A rougelite full of strategy and cute girls!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/c8e54fc94aac542553f165a5069cdda1d0bfa5d8.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710380/
[h1][b]A rougelite full of strategy, cultivation, and cute girls![/b][/h1]
Our heroes are transported to a once-peaceful town consumed by chaos, and can't leave unless they... fight their way out!? Adventure together with a party of cuties and get to the bottom of all this craziness.
[h2]Dozens of Character Types:[/h2]
Customize and cultivate a team of unique fighters, matching their strengths against enemy weaknesses in tense 3v3 battles!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/71352e297b6049c7a943f287504fe07941347698.gif[/img]
[h2]Strategic Dice Battles:[/h2]
Roll each character's unique set of dice to rack up action points, then spend those points on special moves and abilities! You'll have to use your points wisely if you want to defeat every new enemy in your path.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/84b65574519620ac1277f1ba38c367b2375ac2c8.gif[/img]
[h2]Rougelite Design:[/h2]
Fight your way through a new map each time you play, forging your own path forwards. Will you choose to face powerful enemies for epic rewards, or take the easier, safer route? Each choice brings you one step closer to success... or failure!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/f8c15f6ad2243c07f8a6b4af590c6ca3d824dee9.png[/img]

notes.title: Dong-Jin Rice-hime -Expansion Pack Release!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579562/85ccbc0d36c9b5b588b3eafed2a90c1d2904e791.png[/img]

Dong-Jin Rice-hime -Expansion Pack Release!

New contents have been added to Rice-hime! In addition to two new varieties of Rice, we have also included Japanese voice acting!

DLC content includes:
● Cultivate two new varieties of Rice
● Four new achievements
● Events now feature our new Japanese dubbing - CV: Ai Kayano
● New Chinese theme song - lead singer: Xin-nan(薛南), composer: 3R2

Not only this, but events have also been added for the special appearance of AIR (艾兒) and MAGI (小瑪).

p.s. English localization is on going, we will update later.

notes.notes:
Hello players

As the recent adoption of greenlight games more,
STEAM's audit speed is slower than written in the developer's manual.
(2 to 3 days, today is the fourth day of the application.)
Calculate the time difference, we estimate the fastest after Saturday afternoon,
It is possible to publish through the audit (US working hours).
But the actual release time, still depending on the speed of review STEAM may be.
We are very sorry for the distress.
